purpose: Check consistency of all48083 existing deposited CDS translations against existing authenticated DNA; no new design, annotation filling or computed-protein export.

checking_semantics.codon_start: Require a single declared1/2/3; when absent use1 explicitly identified as Biopython1.86 default. Extract location in source strand/join order, then apply codon_start-1 offset.
checking_semantics.positions: Exact bounded positions with uniform +/-strand; simple or nonoverlapping join only. Remote, fuzzy, partial, mixed-strand or overlapping joins unverified.
checking_semantics.DNA: Non-ACGT coding bases remain unverified; no ambiguity resolution.
checking_semantics.multiple_translation_values: Each entry preserved but unverified because the source feature has ambiguous deposited translation alternatives.
checking_semantics.full_coding_check: cds=True requires valid initiation, multiple-of-three length, terminal stop and no internal stop; alternate initiation maps to methionine using declared genetic code.
checking_semantics.comparison: Exact uppercase deposited string equality; no trimming, stop-removal, sequence correction or parameter search. Record computed hash/length/status only, never computed AA sequence.
checking_semantics.mismatch_handling: Preserve IDs and all detail entries without dropping or changing annotations.

source_references.locator: Version11.4 April2026, CDS comment and /codon_start qualifier definition
source_references.supported: codon_start offsets1/2/3; complete amino-termini require1; transl_table and transl_except meanings. This source does not explicitly establish absence-default1.
Extracts source feature, applies codon_start offset; implementation defaults missingcodon_start to0-basedoffset0. Our policy still requires an explicitly declared transl_table.
